title: September 12, 2015 Austin City Council Discussion
transcript:
AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL 
 
COUNCIL DISCUSSION 
SATURDAY, SEPTEMBER 12, 2015 
9:00 AM 
TRAVIS COUNTY EXPO CENTER,  
7311 DECKER LANE, AUSTIN, TX, 78724 
 
 
East Austin Equitable Development Event 
 
Agenda 
 
 
9:00 AM 
Attend a community event to identify guiding principles, core values, 
share ideas, and short and long range goals to foster economic growth and 
amenities in East Austin. 
 
 
 
A quorum of Council members may be present. No action will be taken.  
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the American with Disabilities Act.  
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon 
request.  Meeting locations are planned with wheelchair access.  If requiring Sign 
Language Interpreters or alternative formats, please give notice at least 4 days before the 
meeting date.  Please call Dolores Gonzalez, City of Austin ADA Coordinator, at (512) 
974-3256 for additional information; TTY users route through Relay Texas at 711.
